tagline: Understand electricity, solar panels, batteries and the cost of everyday power.

tool.title: Solar Energy & Savings Calculator
tool.intro: Estimate daily solar production and 30-day electricity value from your local inputs.
tool.formula: Daily energy = installed capacity × peak sun hours × performance ratio. Estimated monthly electricity value uses 30 days.
tool.caution: Not an installer quote: orientation, shading, weather, grid rules, taxes and time-of-use rates affect actual savings.
